Name: Talkohlooeys' Style Jorts and Jean Portraits
Author: Radicalvice
Description:
[b][size=3]Summary:

[/size][/b]A portrait mod. Kitty cats. Talkohlooeys. Yeah.

Found it odd Mister Ginger had this and not these two, so I took it upon myself to do something about it.

These are only images you install with Portraiture. If any of you will be willing and/or daring enough to make a functioning mod with these, give me a ring.

[size=3][b]Installation:
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url];
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url];

[*]This is the tricky bit. Follow the steps in the video of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30727]this mod's[/url]﻿ description and just drop the images I've provided in the portrait folder you've made.
[/list]
[b][size=3]Credits:

[/size][/b]Gorgeous dialogue interface - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39379]Cat Valley(Interface)[/url];
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20181]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' portraits - East Scarp[/url] for cat anatomy reference in this specific style. It's been quite helpful.
